article.story: COLUMBIA, Mo. -- — Jason Crowe Jr. and Bryson Tiller scored 18 points apiece to lead five Missouri players in double figures and the Tigers beat Le Moyne 91-64 on Friday night for their fourth consecutive win. Kennard Davis Jr. had 13 points, Jamier Jones scored 11 and Toni Bryant 10 for Missouri (5-1). Khalil Williams, Ty Francis and Trevor Rowe scored 11 points apiece for Le Moyne (2-4). The Tigers shot 57% from the field, 11 of 25 (55%) from 3-point range, scored 26 points off 16 Le Moyne turnovers and outscored the Dolphins 12-3 in second-chance points. Crowe hit a jumper that gave Missouri the lead for good less than 5 minutes into the game. Crowe, Pierce and Tiller each hit a 3 in an 85-second span to push the lead into double figures and spark a 17-4 run that culminated with back-to-back dunks by Crowe and Jones and made it 31-15 with 8:26 left until halftime. Tiller hit a jumper and a 3-pointer that ignited a 12-0 to close the first half. Bryant added a layup and, after Cord Stansberry took a steal coast to coast for a two-hand dunk, made a 3 that gave the Tigers an 28-point lead at halftime. Jones made two free throws before Crowe stole the inbounds pass, calmly took one dribble to the right corner and knocked down a 3 and Davis followed with a steal and a fast-break dunk 19 seconds later that gave Missouri its biggest lead of the game at 63-26 with 15 minutes to go. Up next Le Moyne: Hosts Division-II Mansfield on Monday.
